lede: Cincinnati carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.7 against +0.2, a 1.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Arizona -8.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Arizona winning 72% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is continuity, where Arizona leads Cincinnati by 89 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 89% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
